encoding_assumptions: Numeric/categorical roles are modeling assumptions, not verified feature definitions. Treat ca and slope as nominal, not ordinal; retain all observed codes including ca=4 and thal=0. Learn one-hot categories only on training groups, handle_unknown=ignore, drop=None. Standardize numeric features only on training groups. No imputation, feature selection, resampling, or label changes. Positive class is numeric target=1, whose clinical meaning remains unverified.
primary_training: One representative (first source occurrence) per distinct feature group; no sample or class weighting.
grouping: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing ordered feature names and parsed raw cell strings, excluding target. Verify full key equality and numeric-normalized grouping equivalence. These are feature groups, not patient IDs.
